spec_features.evidence: harness.py:120 `def run_episode(family, model, task, max_turns=30)` and harness.py:140 `for _ in range(max_turns):` is the actual episode loop; when the counter is exhausted the loop ends and `return messages` runs. The cap is read and bounds execution end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Genuine bounded loop; default 30, overridable via run.py --max-turns. It is the only mechanism that ends an episode.

spec_features.spec_quote: We nudge once per such turn (not infinitely) to avoid badgering and to keep the loop bounded
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:143-150: on a turn with no tool_calls the harness appends exactly one user message ('Continue working on the task, or confirm it is complete.') then `continue`. Exactly one nudge is added per no-tool turn, and the whole thing is still bounded by the max_turns loop, so it cannot nudge infinitely.
spec_features.notes: Wired and executes; the per-turn single nudge plus the for-range loop together bound it. No separate badgering counter, but the behavior matches 'once per such turn, not infinite'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # No tool use: nudge once to keep the loop going, else stop.

spec_features.evidence: harness.py:83-89 Repo.edit_file returns `f"Error: {path} is read-only and cannot be edited. You may only edit: {sorted(self.editable)}."` and this string is dispatched (_dispatch_tool harness.py:106-108) and appended as the tool result delivered to the subject (harness.py:153-158). The message is factual/informative rather than hostile.
spec_features.notes: The error text is actually constructed and sent back to the subject as the tool result each time it tries to edit the protected file. Tone is neutral but there is no code comment stating a non-hostility intent; the wording itself is clear/helpful.

spec_features.spec_quote: The guiding principle throughout was to keep the design minimal
spec_features.evidence: This is design philosophy only, appearing in DESIGN.md prose (e.g. line 6) and module docstrings (models.py 'We deliberately keep this minimal'). There is no code mechanism that enforces, caps, monitors, or protects the subject — nothing executable corresponds to 'minimal'.
spec_features.notes: Pure spec/docstring prose; not an enforced mechanism.
